fields.duration_minutes: Observed telemetry interval represented by one source event.
fields.observed_minutes: Sum of source-event duration_minutes in the reporting grain.
fields.running_minutes: Observed interval minutes classified as running.
fields.idle_minutes: Observed interval minutes classified as idle.
fields.maintenance_minutes: Observed interval minutes classified as maintenance.
fields.downtime_minutes: Incident-attributed outage or repair minutes; independent of telemetry observation coverage.
fields.downtime_pct: Compatibility name for attributed downtime load: downtime_minutes divided by observed_minutes times 100.
fields.downtime_load_pct: Preferred name for attributed downtime load; it is not an availability share and may exceed 100.

consumer_guidance.prohibited_interpretation: Do not describe downtime_pct as a bounded share of observed telemetry time.
